title: Sable Harbor Management System (SHMS)
stewardship: Orientation Officer practice, collaboratively with the Chief Executive Officer

principles.principle: Spend the company's money like it's your own.
Give people room to be wrong.
Don't build bureaucracy to cover for weak management.
Know when to get out of the way.
Build something that can outlast you.
Build the thing you wish existed.

succession: The Orientation Officer practice stewards SHMS collaboratively with the CEO, including as part of each CEO transition.
